title: Book Two · Chapter 62: An Orange in Six Pieces
story:
Ronan reaches the green door after the reading morning. Mum is home from her customer's house. Her shoes stand near the step. She sits in her own chair with an orange on her knee.

“Look,” Ronan says. He takes out his new page.

Mum smiles. “Let me wash my hands first.”

He follows her toward the kitchen and begins the shoe story. Mum stops by the basin.

“Give me a little time, please. My hands are still dirty from outside.”

Ronan puts the page on the table. Dad goes to put his work things away. The room becomes quiet for a moment.

Mum washes and dries her hands. Then she sits down again. She pats the empty chair. Ronan brings his page to her.

He tells the story from the beginning. At the muddy path, his voice slows. Mum looks at the picture and waits. Ronan says the word and goes on.

“Then the shoe is there,” he says.

“Does it still fit?”

“Yes. It is just dirty.”

“A useful ending.”

Mum peels the orange. She divides it into six pieces and puts them on a small plate. Dad returns with three cups.

Ronan takes one piece. He wants to say that the reading room is better than school. The chairs are newer. There are more little cards. The teacher has time to help with his difficult word.

“Can we go every week?”

Mum keeps her hands on the plate.

“We agreed to one visit. Today is that visit.”

“I know. But it is very good.”

“I am glad it is good.”

Ronan looks at Dad. Dad gives him a cup, but no new promise.

He drinks. There is still a sharp orange smell on his fingers. He feels a little sad again. Then Mum asks about the child beside him. He tells her about the two pencils.

After lunch, Mum takes her blue skirt from the hook. She is going to visit her friend. Her customer has the finished clothes. This afternoon she has time for herself.

“Can you hear the story again tonight?” Ronan asks.

“After supper.”

He puts his page in his folder. Dad offers to go to the square later. By then, the sun will be lower. Ronan looks out at the blue bike in the yard.

“Can we take water?”

“Yes.”

Mum takes the last piece of orange from the plate. Ronan reaches for it at the same time. Both hands stop. Mum laughs. She breaks the piece in two. She gives him half.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

piece＝一块；peel＝剥皮；plate＝盘子。

## 理解问题

1. Ronan回家后最想马上做什么？
2. Mum怎样有自己的休息时间？

## 读句子

**Mum / peels / the orange.** Mum／剥开／橙子。
